LUCIEN BECKNER

BECKNER

MAY 27 Ans'd

TELEPHONE 478

THE PRINTING

COMPANY

"WE NEVER DISAPPOINT"

136, 138, 140 West Short Street

LEXINGTON, KY.

Man 22, 1914.

Hon. Herdon Rosunet, Ople Day. K. Y. Dear dis:

In common with hoprescives all vor the Wined late, dam delights at sor returm firm the cilds. • Is fast, we are is stan wild here in its states and need a leade to show no to way ort. ninth of march, tit indy top me on the whether the shipment arrived in good order. I remain, with great respect, your obedient servant. The committe will will meet again on Tuesday evening at seven. Enclosed please find the receip for the amount paid in full. I remain, with great respect, your obedient servant. The committee will meet again on Tuesday evening at seven. Enclosed
